Deine Aufgaben

Über die Rolle
Wir suchen dich als Senior Project Manager für unseren großen Kunden aus dem Automobilbereich am Standort Hamburg. Da du intern wie extern die kommunikativen Fäden in der Hand hältst und direkt mit dem Kunden am Tisch sitzt, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse für diese Rolle deine absolute Basis. Dein Fokus liegt zu einhundert Prozent auf der Betreuung, Pflege und redaktionellen Weiterentwicklung komplexer digitaler Webplattformen. Du verantwortest den langfristigen und nachhaltigen Betrieb unserer digitalen Produkte. Als Senior bist du das strategische und organisatorische Rückgrat für unsere Content Teams sowie UX Designer und stellst sicher, dass neue Inhalte strukturiert, geprüft und pünktlich live gehen.

Deine Aufgaben
Du übernimmst die operative Steuerung und die strategische Planung von großen digitalen Pflegeprojekten sowie weltweiten Content Rollouts. Dabei agierst du als zentrale und souveräne Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden, der Kreation und den redaktionellen Teams.
Dein Arbeitsalltag ist geprägt von agilen Methoden. Du übersetzt komplexe inhaltliche Anforderungen in klare Aufgabenpakete, führst das Backlog und koordinierst die Sprints sicher über Jira. Für eine saubere Dokumentation und den transparenten Wissenstransfer nutzt du Confluence.
Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis für Content Management Systeme und steuerst die kontinuierliche Pflege sowie redaktionelle Befüllung der Plattform. Qualität ist für dich kein Zufall. Du planst umfassende Abnahmen für Texteingaben und Bildmaterial und gibst keine neuen Seiten live, die nicht unseren hohen Standards entsprechen.
Du behältst Timings, Ressourcen und Budgets für die kontinuierliche Betreuung der Plattform stets im Blick. Als Senior bewahrst du auch in stressigen Phasen einen kühlen Kopf und leitest dein Projektteam sicher durch komplexe Publikationsprozesse.


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: Du hast langjährige Erfahrung im digitalen Projektmanagement gesammelt und dabei große Webplattformen oder redaktionelle Rollouts hauptverantwortlich gesteuert.
  • Plattform Wissen: Du kennst dich hervorragend mit modernen Content Management Systemen aus und verstehst die Prozesse hinter erfolgreicher digitaler Redaktion und Plattformpflege.
  • Agilität: Du bist ein absoluter Profi im Umgang mit agilen Arbeitsweisen und steuerst Workflows routiniert über Jira und Confluence.
  • Leadership: Du sprichst die Sprache der Content Creator genau so fließend wie die der Kunden. Du trittst absolut sicher auf und führst dein Projektteam mit klarer Orientierung.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest extrem strukturiert, bringst eine hohe Lösungsorientierung mit und bewahrst bei umfassenden Content Rollouts stets die Ruhe.
  • Sprache: Neben deinen fließenden Deutschkenntnissen kommunizierst du auch auf Englisch absolut sicher und verbindlich.


Warum wir?

  • Bei uns erwartet dich ein attraktiver Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von St. Pauli verbunden mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten
  • Du triffst auf eine offene Agenturkultur, die von Kreativität und Menschlichkeit geleitet ist
  • Der respektvolle Umgang miteinander auf Augenhöhe ist bei uns Prinzip
  • Bei uns hast du Eigenverantwortung und wirst zu selbstständigem Arbeiten motiviert
  • Du wirst inhaltlich geführt und hast Raum für deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung
  • Du profitierst von unserer globalen DDB-Trainingsplattform mit umfangreichen Fachthemen und Skill-Trainings (u.a. LinkedIn Learning und Babbel)
  • Förderung deiner Mobilität (Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets sowie Kooperation mit Jobrad) 
  • Mit Angeboten, wie einer Kooperation mit dem PME-Familienservice sowie Wellhub, wollen wir deine Gesundheit unterstützen
  • Leckeres Frühstück mit frischem Brot an deinen Bürotagen
  • Du hast die Möglichkeit, regelmäßig von zu Hause zu arbeiten 


Unser Standort

Wir sind in St.Pauli, im Zirkusweg zwischen Reeperbahn und Elbe. Zwischen schreienden Möwen und gemeinsamen Abenden in den berüchtigtsten und liebenswertesten Kneipen auf dem Kiez. Immer im Austausch, gerne auch im 19. Stock. Dann reden wir darüber, was wir noch nicht gesehen haben. Was wir vorhaben und wie wir das zusammen schaffen. Mit viel Vertrauen zueinander und noch mehr Leidenschaft. Wir lieben es Marken digital zu begleiten, zu führen und erfolgreiche Lösungen zu entwickeln. Für Kunden wie zum Beispiel Volkswagen, Lufthansa und IKEA Austria. 

Wir freuen uns auf jeden Menschen. Und auf alle Bewerbungen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion und Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

Join our growing People team! We're hiring a Lead People Partner to own the people agenda for our Technology organisation as M-KOPA scales the infrastructure behind financial inclusion for everyday earners across Africa.

The Impact 🌍


Your leadership will directly shape how we build, retain and grow the engineering talent powering our mission. We've now reached 10 million customers and unlocked $2+ billion in credit across five African markets. This role sits right at the centre of the machine that makes that growth possible.

The Opportunity

💚 Mission-driven HR: Partner directly with our CTO and their leadership team across Engineering, Data, Analytics, IT and Security — work that translates straight into digital and financial access for everyday earners

🏆 Global recognition: Join a company named by TIME 100 as one of the world's most influential, and by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest-growing company for 5 consecutive years (2022–2026)

🚀 Scale challenges: Design the org structure for a globally distributed, senior engineering population spread across Africa, Europe and the UK — scaling and reshaping at the same time

🌱 Environmental impact: Work for a carbon-negative company that has displaced over 2 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions

What You'll Do

You'll act as trusted advisor to our engineering, data and platform leaders, aligning people strategy to roadmap execution and organisational evolution. You'll hold overall accountability for people partnering across the full Technology and Product organisation, with one Senior People Partner reporting to you covering Product and adjacent functions. Your own focus is Engineering: a globally distributed, senior population where genuine fluency in how engineering organisations are built, levelled and retained matters far more than adjacency to them.

data.description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

Our perspective on GTM.

We believe that sales has fundamentally changed in the last 6 months. The repetitive work is automated now: AI does the market research, drafts the emails, summarises and scores the calls.

The last year has taught us that the people who succeed have a blend of the following traits.

  • Intellectual dexterity: consultant-like ability to structure and break down a problem into its constituent parts, think from first principles, and self-improve rapidly. Inherent curiosity goes a long way here.

  • Natural charisma: can build rapport with anyone. You work out quickly who you're talking to, what they're dealing with and what they actually need, then have the conversation that gets you both somewhere.

  • Drive & focus: as AI commoditises intelligence, work ethic and agency matter more. An outlier candidate here is far more productive than the mean than they were two years ago, and the gap keeps widening.

  • The mark of humanity: in a world filling up with AI slop, work where you can feel the person behind it stands out. Where the copy, the imagery, and the strategy is indelibly human.

We don't think the talent market has caught up with this shift yet, which is why most of our GTM team came from outside the profession: VC, consulting and creative are common.

We expect these roles to become far more desirable for the right people. High leverage, high reward, intellectually stimulating. We want you to be part of that.

The role.

Clinicians outside the NHS - in private healthcare, veterinary, CICs and more - are finding Heidi, using it and telling their colleagues. Your job is to turn that individual enthusiasm into a decision for the whole clinic: understand what’s working, who else needs to be involved and what it will take to get the team onboard.

You’ll own the full sales cycle across small and medium-sized private healthcare businesses in the UK. You might speak to an independent specialist who runs their own practice, a clinic manager bringing several clinicians together or an owner making decisions across multiple sites. You’ll need to understand the clinical workflow and the business behind it, then help them make a confident decision.

There’s volume here, and you’ll need to move quickly. We’ll help you view your pipeline systemically - what inputs and opportunities are needed, where you invest your time, what changes will make the greatest difference. Sales craft matters, as does knowing where to apply it. You’ll have the autonomy to test that judgement, with experienced people around you to sharpen it.

We’re ambitious about the numbers and care deeply about what they represent: clinicians getting time back and patients getting more of their attention. People here push themselves, share what works and help each other get better. As AI changes what a salesperson can do, we expect you to question how we work and help build what comes next.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own deals from the first qualified conversation through to close, working with our deployment and customer success teams to get clinics using Heidi successfully.

  • Turn inbound interest and product usage signals into paid adoption. Work out where one clinician’s enthusiasm could become a rollout across the business, and bring the right people into the conversation.

  • Shape and execute our outbound motion to create a scalable % of sourced deals.

  • Get close to how each clinic works. Run discovery and demos that connect Heidi to the problems clinicians, managers and owners actually want to solve.

  • Own your revenue number and the pipeline needed to deliver it. Know your opportunity volume, conversion rates, deal sizes and sales cycle well enough to spot a shortfall early and act.

  • Find where deals get stuck. Apply sales frameworks where they improve decisions and win rates, with enough judgement to keep straightforward deals moving quickly.

  • Use AI and tools like HubSpot and Omni to reduce repetitive work, understand your accounts and improve how you sell. Test ideas, measure the result and share what works.

  • Feed what you hear back into the business: why customers buy, why they hesitate, what competitors are doing and what would make adoption easier.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • You’ve shown you can turn a good conversation into a commercial outcome. That might be in sales, consulting, creative, growth, or another role where you’ve had to deeply understand a need, earn trust and secure a decision.

  • You can think in systems and work with numbers. If your pipeline is underperforming, you can break the problem down, form a view on what needs to change and test it.

  • You build rapport quickly and ask showstopping questions. You’re comfortable talking to a clinician about their working day and a business owner about whether an investment makes sense.

  • You can keep a lot of deals moving without losing the detail. You run your own day, follow through on commitments and know where your attention will have the most impact.

  • You’re curious about sales craft and thoughtful about how you use it. You want to understand why an approach works and when to adapt it.

  • You use AI hands-on and have ideas about where it can improve your work. When something is slow or repetitive, you look for a way to fix it.

  • You’re driven, open to coaching and willing to change your mind. You care about your own performance and put time into helping the people around you succeed.

  • You care about what Heidi does. You’ll learn the product properly, take clinicians’ concerns seriously and keep their experience in view as you work towards your target.

Bonus if you:

  • Have closed deals in a high-volume SMB sales environment.

  • Know UK private healthcare, particularly how independent practices and clinics buy and adopt new tools.

  • Have worked in a product-led business and used product signals to identify and grow opportunities.

  • Have built an AI workflow or automation that made you or your team more effective.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

Our EMEA organization translates OpenAI’s global mission and strategy into meaningful local impact, working across Growth, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Finance, Research, Operations and Compliance.

As Strategy and Operations lead, you will develop country strategies, identify the most important market opportunities and barriers, align cross-functional teams around a focused set of priorities, and personally drive initiatives through to measurable outcomes.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the role

 

We are seeking a high-energy, results-driven Strategic Account Manager (SME) to join our team. This is a unique opportunity to become a founding member of our growing Airwallex team in France, specifically focused on scaling our high-growth SME accounts. You will be instrumental in driving expansion, maximising Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and ensuring deep product adoption across a strategic portfolio of 50+ SME accounts. If you are passionate about product, revenue, and impact—and enjoy solving real-world business challenges using technical solutions—this role offers you the chance to make a tangible impact and grow with one of the world’s fastest-growing fintech companies.

 

What you’ll do

 

As a Strategic Account Manager, you will own and develop a portfolio of SME accounts recently signed by our Sales team. Your mission will be to drive expansion through upsell and cross-sell strategies, maximise NRR, and ensure adoption of Airwallex’s product suite. You will work as a critical bridge between customers and our product teams, translating client needs into innovative product solutions and helping to shape our go-to-market approach in France.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Drive upsell and cross-sell strategy for your portfolio to exceed quarterly expansion targets and revenue KPIs.

  • Become a power-user of the Airwallex platform and act as a product advisor, recommending optimal API configurations or feature sets based on clients' technical setups.

  • Manage a high-volume portfolio of 50+ accounts, implementing a structured framework to identify and capitalize on high-impact growth opportunities.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to translate customer requirements into actionable product roadmaps, advocating for client needs in the French market.

  • Help build and refine the Account Management "playbook" for France, ensuring scalable onboarding and activation processes.

  • Proactively monitor account health and product usage metrics to mitigate churn and ensure long-term platform loyalty.

 

Who you are

 

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

 

Minimum qualifications:

 

  • Native or bilingual fluency in French and professional proficiency in English.

  • At least 5 years of Account Management or Sales experience managing SME or Mid-Market portfolios.

  • Deep understanding of Fintech or Payments (card issuing, acquiring, FX, or global payment rails is a significant plus).

  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales or upsell targets, with a revenue-driven mindset.

  • Strong operational rigor with the ability to multi-task and prioritize across 50+ accounts.

  • Product-first mindset and comfortable discussing API documentation, payment flows, and technical integrations with both CFOs and technical stakeholders.

 

Preferred qualifications:

 

  • Self-starter with a problem-solving mindset and a passion for building new markets from the ground up.

  • Experience advocating for customer needs to influence product development.

  • Prior experience in a fast-growing or startup fintech environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex customer portfolios and prioritize for greatest impact.

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

We are growing! We are currently looking to hire an experienced Automotive Business Development Director – Premium & Luxury for our Paris office.  

About CXG: 

Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide.  

The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation.  

We are passionate about delivering impact. 

Our clients include the world’s most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction.

Overview

We are currently looking to hire an experienced Automotive Business Development Director – Premium & Luxury, based in our Paris office. This is a strategic and highly commercial role for an entrepreneurial automotive expert who can leverage a strong senior network, create and convert new business opportunities, and help CXG expand its position with leading premium and luxury automotive brands.

What you will be doing

Reporting to CXG Chief Customer Officer, you will lead the commercial development of CXG's Automotive Industry practice. Your responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to, the following:

 1.    Automotive Business Development Leadership

  • Lead the commercial development of CXG's Automotive Industry practice, with direct ownership of new client acquisition and market expansion.
  • Update and maintain a compelling Automotive value proposition that leverages CXG's capabilities, methodologies, resources, differentiators, and data, and addresses the priorities of stakeholders across the industry and regions, including brands, importers, distributors, and showroom management.
  • Promote the value proposition internally and externally and constantly search for new ways to improve it.
  • Serve as CXG's internal and external automotive industry expert and the key point of contact for automotive projects, strategic client discussions, and new business opportunities.
  • Develop and execute a clear commercial strategy to acquire new automotive clients, personally leveraging an established senior network to generate qualified opportunities, build a strong pipeline, and convert prospects into sustainable revenue.
  • Ensure all relevant parties are included in proposal preparation, so the most powerful offers are presented to prospects while taking current and future operational capacity into account.
  • Establish the annual business plan, including revenue ambitions, priority accounts, pipeline targets, key commercial actions, and market development initiatives.
  • Monitor the commercial performance of CXG's Automotive Industry practice, including pipeline development, conversion, and revenue growth, and provide clear reporting to management and the Executive Committee.

2.    Client Development and Internal Expertise

  • New client acquisition sits at the heart of this role. It is the primary criterion and the main measure of success.
  • Create measurable value for both prospects and existing clients by connecting their business priorities with CXG's full range of capabilities.
  • For existing clients, work closely with the CSMs responsible for automotive accounts and join meetings at key milestones, including the presentation of deliverables, discussions about account growth opportunities, and conversations on current client challenges. Use your expertise to strengthen the client dialogue, help resolve issues, and maximize additional business opportunities.
  • Act as the internal subject matter expert for the CSMs managing automotive accounts, sharing relevant market, client, and industry knowledge to strengthen their credibility and effectiveness.
  • Coach CSMs to identify whitespace, develop account expansion plans, and build stronger relationships with senior client stakeholders. Join client meetings whenever your expertise can increase the value of the discussion or support the conversion of an opportunity.
  • Advise clients on CXG's Automotive value proposition, and ensure discussions cover our Measurement, Academy, Customer Insights, and Consulting capabilities.
  • Own the business development effort for the Automotive Industry practice, from market mapping and opportunity creation through proposal development, negotiation, and conversion.
  • Develop and nurture CXG's visibility and credibility across relevant automotive markets through active networking, industry events, thought leadership, and white papers.

Requirements

What you will bring along

This role requires a genuine passion for the automotive and luxury industries.

You should also have the below:

  • Master's degree in Luxury Management, Business Administration, or a related field from a Business School or similar institution.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in the automotive sector, with significant exposure to consulting, marketing, sales, or business development in the premium or luxury segment.
  • Fluent English is mandatory, with German as a plus and French as a nice-to-have.
  • An extensive and active network of senior decision-makers across the premium and luxury automotive sector, with the credibility and relationship-building skills to open doors, create qualified opportunities, and position CXG's value proposition. This is a core requirement for the role.
  • A strong and demonstrable business development track record, including originating opportunities, managing complex sales cycles, and winning new clients or expanding strategic accounts.
  • Demonstrable experience developing strategic and business plans.
  • Deep knowledge of the premium and luxury automotive market, its commercial ecosystem, client priorities, and the trends and forces shaping the industry's development.
  • Good understanding of corporate finance and measures of performance.
  • Excellent organizational and leadership skills.
  • Positive and outgoing personality.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, polished, persuasive, and diplomatic, with experience in presentations and proposal writing.
  • Outstanding analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • A strong consulting approach and the ability to coach client-facing teams, translate industry expertise into commercial opportunities, and influence senior stakeholders.

Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE

Rattaché(e) à la Direction de la Communication Groupe et accompagné(e) par un référent Communication ainsi qu'un référent Tech, vous rejoindrez une équipe qui souhaite moderniser ses outils internes et explore les opportunités offertes par l'IA générative pour répondre à des besoins métiers.

Depuis plusieurs mois, l'équipe développe et teste différents outils internes grâce aux approches de prototypage rapide assistées par l'IA : dashboards de pilotage, plateformes d'inscription aux événements, assistants métiers ou encore outils de suivi de projets.

Votre mission sera de contribuer à faire évoluer ces premiers prototypes vers des solutions plus robustes, pérennes et intégrées à l'écosystème Veepee. Vous travaillerez à la croisée des enjeux métier, produit et techniques, avec un impact direct sur le quotidien des équipes.


🎯 MISSIONS

Votre mission principale sera de faire passer ces projets du stade de prototype à celui de produits robustes, intégrés aux standards et à l'écosystème technique de Veepee. 

  • Consolidation : Reprendre les prototypes développés par l’équipe Communication pour rendre le code propre, stable et maintenable.

  • Intégration : Travailler main dans la main avec l'équipe Tech pour adapter ces outils aux contraintes et aux systèmes de Veepee.

  • Fonctionnalités IA : Tester et intégrer des briques IA (API LLM, automatisation) pour répondre aux besoins métiers de l’équipe Communication.

  • Documentation : Rédiger la documentation technique minimale pour faciliter la reprise des projets.


    • 👉ENCADREMENT & ENVIRONNEMENT

    Vous serez rattaché(e) à l'équipe Communication tout en bénéficiant d'un double tutorat :

  • Un référent Com pour la vision métier et le suivi des projets.

  • Un mentor Tech pour vous guider sur les bonnes pratiques de développement, la revue de code et le déploiement chez Veepee.


    • 👉 PRE-REQUIS

  • Formation en développement / informatique Bac+5, en école d'ingénieur, université ou équivalent, avec une première expérience de code (projets perso, académiques, stages précédents)

  • Maîtrise d'un langage backend (Python, Node.js...) et des notions frontend (React, Vue...).

  • Bonne maîtrise des bases du développement web (backend et/ou frontend).

  • Curiosité marquée pour les outils IA (manipulation d'API type OpenAI/Claude, scripts, etc.).

  • À l'aise avec Git.

  • Esprit d'initiative, envie d'apprendre au contact d'une équipe Tech et aisance relationnelle. 

  • Anglais professionnel courant (niveau B2 minimum).

    • Une expérience avec des outils comme Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, Firebase, Supabase ou des technologies similaires est un plus.


    ✅ BENEFITS
  • 👉Bureau flexible avec au minimum 3 jours sur place et jusqu'à 2 jours à domicile
  • 👉Plate-forme d'apprentissage des langues en ligne
  • 👉Comité d’entreprise CE et ses nombreux avantages
  • 👉Accès à une restauration d'entreprise et cantine connecté
  • 👉Accès à la Salle de sport
  • 👉Congés selon la durée du contrat

    • 1️⃣ Entretien RH d’environ 30 min

    • 2️⃣ Entretien Manager

    • 3️⃣ Entretien Tech

data.description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

 

Team

As a French tech leader and global successful company, our Talent Acquisition teams are constantly looking for ways to innovate and increase organization efficiency to keep Voodoo ahead of the market. The main focus of the team is to understand how the business strategy will impact our hiring plan, and provide support to find and attract our new talents.

 

You will work hand in hand with our Growth team, which is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech across various types of games (hypercasual, hybrid, 100% IAP).

 

You will be working on highly scalable mobile games, played by millions of people. You will be part of a small and high-performing team and will have the opportunity to grow your skills by hiring A-Players all around the world.

 

Role

Join us as Voodoo's very first Talent Sourcer, embedded in the Growth BU (for both Gaming and Consumer Applications). In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and building strong relationships with top passive talent to fuel the Growth team's hiring across a wide range of profiles — from Marketing specialist, Artist, Developers, etc.

  • Design and execute proactive sourcing strategies tailored to each role, going far beyond LinkedIn Recruiter — think communities, newsletters, events, niche forums, conference speaker lists, and creative outreach

  • Write sharp, personalized, and compelling outreach messages that spark genuine interest and reflect Voodoo's culture and ambitions

  • Build and maintain active talent pools and pipelines for current and future hiring needs, with a strong focus on nurturing long-term relationships

  • Conduct in-depth market mapping to understand talent landscapes, track competitor moves, and identify where the best profiles are and how to reach them

  • Balance volume and quality: manage multiple searches simultaneously while maintaining a high bar for candidate relevance and experience

  • Leverage AI tools and automation (e.g. Claude, ATS) to enhance sourcing efficiency, personalize outreach at scale, and track performance

  • Track and analyze sourcing metrics and iterate on your sourcing strategy

  • Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to deeply understand role requirements, team culture and what makes a profile truly stand out - Conducting screening calls might also be a possibility

  • Continuously benchmark sourcing practices and bring fresh, outside-the-box ideas to attract hard-to-reach talent

 

Profile

  • Proven experience in talent sourcing, recruiting, or a research-intensive role — ideally in a fast-paced tech or gaming environment

  • Resourceful and creative: you think beyond LinkedIn and know how to find talent where others don't look

  • Strong written communication skills — you craft outreach messages that people actually want to reply to

  • Proficient with modern sourcing tools and AI and always looking for what's next

  • Strategic thinker: you build and nurture pipelines proactively, not just reactively

  • Data-driven and organized, with the ability to juggle volume and quality across multiple searches at once

  • Collaborative and curious, with a genuine interest in understanding talent markets and staying ahead of trends

Benefits

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • Remote days on Fridays

Role

We’re looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer interested in creating something bigger to join our Engineering & Data team! In this role, you’ll be working on highly scalable solutions, used by millions of people and will solve complex problems including challenges like scalability, high availability, performance, optimization & automation. You will use best-in-class services and technologies, including AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows, and will contribute to improving the technical stack.

  • Design and implement availability, scalability, and performance plans for the services environments

  • Continual re-evaluation of existing stack and infrastructure to maintain optimal performance, availability and security

  • Develop security capabilities and encourage adoption of security best practices and architecture changes throughout the company via evangelism and education

  • Take ownership of automating infrastructure deployment and configuration, lead the creation of CI/CD pipelines for applications, and develop CI/CD best practices across the team

  • Leverage AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code or similar harnesses) to accelerate infrastructure development, automate repetitive engineering tasks, and raise the team's overall velocity

  • Design, deploy, and scale autonomous or semi-autonomous agents to handle infrastructure operations, incident response, and internal tooling workflows

  • Perform development, automation, and deployment assignments without close supervision

  • Provide application development and cloud technology leadership, guidance, and assistance to other team members, including best practices for integrating AI tools into engineering workflows

  • Control costs and be able to propose and implement new solutions in coordination with dev teams

Profile (Must Have)

  • 5+ years of Linux experience including experience with scripting, networks, storage, and release

  • 3+ years building and maintaining continuous integration environments and working with AWS

  • 3+ years working with Kubernetes

  • Strong understanding of the infrastructure as code and immutability principles including Terraform

  • Experience with high traffic, distributed systems architectures, and related tools (service discovery, config/secret management, etc.)

  • Experience designing and managing AWS Landing Zone architectures (multi-account strategy, org-level guardrails, centralized networking/logging/security)

  • Experience in any scripting language (python, bash, …)

  • Practical experience incorporating AI-assisted coding tools or agentic frameworks (such as Cursor, Claude Code, or similar solutions) into production software development workflows

  • Ability to adapt to multiple stakeholders and demonstrate strong cross-teams cooperation

Profile (Nice to Have)

  • Supporting data pipeline orchestration (ETL, Spark, Airflow)

  • Running a distributed message broker at scale (Kafka, NATS)

  • Running GPU workloads on Kubernetes

  • Supporting ML workloads

  • Hands-on expertise in designing, deploying, and maintaining agentic systems in production environments (including multi-agent orchestration, tool integration frameworks, and comprehensive agent observability and monitoring)

  • Experience in golang is a plus

Our Stack

AWS; Terraform; Kubernetes; Prometheus; ArgoCD; Circle-Ci; Github Actions; Atlantis; Grafana; Claude Code (or similar AI coding harnesses)

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Swile Lunch voucher

About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

This is a part-time role offering two to three days of work per week for a three-month contract.

 

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

This is an opportunity to bring your ideas to life, to create your games, in an enjoyable and benign working environment among gaming lovers. Your games will be published by the worldwide leader in this field. You will get the chance to join a newly created small studio, focusing on creating and testing new hyper casual game prototypes to be published by Voodoo. You will have autonomy, a strong impact on the ideation, and a unique opportunity to reach hundreds of millions of players. You will take an innovative approach to gameplay ideas/features and give them their own spin.

 

Role

With this role, you will be core to the company by contributing daily to important decisions with a multidisciplinary team of passionate and talented people. Flesh out the details of a game's design, oversee its testing, and revise the game in response to player feedback. Thanks to your creativity and your teamwork, let’s entertain millions of people with your hit games.

Our studios are looking for people who bring their own ideas and are always willing to compromise to move forward.

 

  • Support the Lead Artist in the ideation and execution of the game’s vision.

  • Design and implement a high-quality, scalable UI from concept to final integration in Unity.

  • Create and maintain a comprehensive UI Style Bible and reusable component libraries.

  • Create high-quality 3D assets (characters, assets, props and environment art) and ensure optimal performance across mobile devices.

  • Setup, integrate, and animate UI scenes in Unity.

  • Work with Game Designers to ensure UI supports gameplay and accessibility goals.

  • Improve and work on LiveOps

  • Iterate quickly based on team feedback and live user data.

  • Propose creative ideas to boost player engagement and improve the user experience.

 

Profile

  • Strong Unity skills, with the ability to implement and optimise directly in engine.

  • Excellent 3D design skills, with a keen eye for visual hierarchy, composition, and readability.

  • Good UI experience

  • A keen eye for emerging mobile game trends with the ability to creatively deconstruct and learn from success cases.

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional remote teams.

  • Fluent in English.

 

Benefits

• Best-in-class compensation

• Other benefits according to the country you reside

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Your mission

Brokers play a structural role in how large and very large employers select, negotiate, and manage their health and prévoyance coverage. We're looking for a Broker Partnerships Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with the brokers who operate in the Enterprise segment, turning Alan into a trusted, credible, and commercially compelling partner for those actors, and supporting our Enterprise Sales and Key Account Management teams.

⭐ Location

On-site in Paris, Île-de-France.

What makes this role genuinely unique

  • You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health insurance companies builds its relationships with the brokers operating in the large and very large employer segment across France, and beyond.

  • You'll have real ownership from day one and operate at the highest levels of the broker market.

  • You'll shape Alan’s broker strategy and execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability. The playbook is yours to define and scale.

  • You'll work directly with Alan's Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, Insurance, and Executive Leadership.

⭐ Your role

Relationships & Presence

  • Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the brokers that sit between us and the largest employers in our markets (whether private or public), at senior and managing director level.

  • Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design Alan's engagement strategy.

  • Be the consistent Alan voice that brokers recognize: someone who shows up, follows through, and is known as easy to deal with without giving away what shouldn't be given.

Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Commercial work

  • Be a partner to our Enterprise Sales and KAM teams on every broker situation: drive strategic decisions deal by deal and turn ecosystem knowledge into commercial leverage.

  • Introduce the right broker contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, transforming relationship capital into pipeline access on large and very large accounts.

  • Share Alan's value and positioning with broker partners to help them understand, represent, and actively promote Alan within their client portfolios.

  • Hold the line on our non-negotiables while finding creative ways to make the collaboration work for both sides.

Sector Engagement & Anticipation

  • Follow the broker market at deal level and ecosystem level: who is growing, who is consolidating, where portfolio shifts are happening, and what it means for Alan's pipeline and positioning.

  • Be a sharp, early internal voice on where the broker market is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy, including on consolidation, regulation, and competitive dynamics.

Build & Scale

  • Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on broker positions, portfolio footprints, engagement history, and contractual frameworks shared with Enterprise Sales and KAM teams to increase win rates.

  • Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our broker engagement and contract documentation (conventions de courtage, commission tracking, data sharing agreements).

  • Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Commercial team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

  • Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how brokers position Alan vs. incumbents, how they advise clients on insurer selection, and where we are perceived as "difficult to work with" — and feed that back into product, pricing, and GTM strategy.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of total experience working with or inside the broker ecosystem: at a broker or in an external partnership or distribution role at a health insurer or mutuelle

  • Have legitimate credibility at senior broker level: ability to engage managing director and senior leadership at major brokers as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive deal-level engagement on the insurer or employer side

  • Have deep knowledge of the broker ecosystem in the large and very large employer segment: how brokers operate, how they are compensated, how they advise clients, and how they influence insurer selection at this scale

  • Have deep understanding of health and prévoyance insurance: the technical dimension (garanties, gestion, régimes, prévoyance) must be native, not learned on the job

  • Have proven ability to build trust with broker counterparts from the insurer or employer side: long-game, trustworthy, discreet, commercially disciplined

  • Demonstrate outstanding stakeholder management: calm, ego-free, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself and equally able to hold firm positions internally when sales pressure pushes toward broker accommodation beyond our framework

  • Demonstrate commercial impact from prior broker-related work: broker relationships that translated into material deal flow, pipeline access, or portfolio migration

  • Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with limited process and real autonomy

  • Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-H level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Chez Moka.Care nous réinventons la façon de voir la santé mentale en entreprise. Nous croyons en des équipes qui se sentent bien pour une organisation saine.

Nous avons levé 17,5 millions d'euros auprès d'investisseurs et de business angels de premier rang.

La culture d'entreprise, ce n'est pas juste des jolis mots que l'on affiche sur les murs. Nous incarnons des valeurs tangibles : l’empathie comme fondement, un optimisme insatiable, une responsabilité partagée et de l’agilité.
 

🧑‍💻 Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi 

Au sein de l’équipe Marketing & Communication, et sous la responsabilité de Pauline, Responsable Communication & Marketing Produit, tu auras pour objectifs principaux de :

  • Satisfaire et engager nos clients en communiquant sur nos innovations, en créant des supports et argumentaires pour nos consultants, et en coordonnant des événements pour notre communauté RH.
  • Augmenter l’adoption de notre produit par nos utilisateurs (les salariés des entreprises clientes de Moka.Care) en créant des visuels percutants et en accompagnant nos consultants sur le terrain.
  • Développer la notoriété de Moka.Care, en contribuant à des campagnes créatives et impactantes, qui valorisent notre expertise et notre raison d’être.
Tu travailleras en collaboration très étroite avec nos consultants qui accompagnent nos clients au quotidien.
 

👉 Tes futures missions 

Engagement clients

  • Animer notre communauté de DRH via des événements premium : Club RH (Take.Care Connect), soirée d'été, webinars clients centrés sur le produit Moka...
  • Partager les nouvelles fonctionnalités et nouvelles offres à nos clients via des newsletters, des emails et des communications dans la plateforme RH.
  • Créer des slides et des éléments de langage précis pour aider nos consultants à vendre nos offres et présenter nos nouveautés.

Engagement utilisateurs

  • Participer aux événements de lancement et stands dans les entreprises pour présenter Moka.Care aux salariés.
  • Créer des posters, des vidéos, des goodies et tous types de supports visuels pour donner envie aux salariés d’utiliser Moka.Care.
  • Communiquer auprès de nos utilisateurs sur les atouts de l'app et ses nouvelles fonctionnalités, via des emails dédiés, des notifications in-app...

Notoriété et thought leadership

  • Rédiger des communiqués de presse et des tribunes pour renforcer la visibilité médiatique de Moka.Care.
  • Produire des contenus (interviews vidéos, pages du site, slides...) pour valoriser nos histoires clients.
  • Participer à l'élaboration de campagnes de marque et d'actions d'influence pour faire rayonner notre expertise auprès de décideurs stratégiques.
 
L'entraide est très importante chez Moka.
De temps en temps, tu prêteras main forte aux autres membres de l'équipe Marketing & Communication sur des projets divers, par exemple : aider à l’organisation d’événements et webinaires de prospection, créer des contenus pour le blog, le site ou Linkedin...

📇 Tu es la personne idéale si 

  • Tu as au moins 2 à 3 ans d’expérience en communication externe et/ou interne.
  • Tu es à l'aise à l'oral, et sais adapter ton discours à des interlocuteurs corporate exigeants.
  • Tu sais piloter des projets en autonomie, organiser tes priorités et prendre des initiatives.
  • Tu fais preuve de professionnalisme et d’un vrai sens de l’esthétique dans les contenus visuels que tu crées.
  • Tu maîtrises un ou plusieurs outils de design (nous utilisons Figma). Si tu as des compétences en montage vidéo, c’est un vrai plus.
  • Tu as le sens du storytelling et du mot qui fait mouche.
  • Tu disposes d’un bon niveau d’anglais, te permettant de comprendre et traiter des communications professionnelles.

🚀 En nous rejoignant tu vas 

  • Participer à une aventure entrepreneuriale avec une mission forte.
  • Grandir en tant que personne et apprendre au sein d'une équipe humaine, exigeante et solidaire.
  • Voir chaque jour l'impact concret de ton travail, et participer à notre ambition : devenir leader européen de la prévention en santé mentale au travail. 
  • Aller sur le terrain, à la rencontre des utilisateurs et futurs utilisateurs de Moka.Care.
  • Être responsable de tes objectifs dès le départ : nous recrutons des personnes pour nous mener un cran plus loin.

🤩 Nous prenons soin de toi

  • Accès à Moka.Care : app, sessions individuelles, formations mensuelles et la possibilité de tester les nouvelles fonctionnalités.
  • Work-life balance: 60% au bureau (on veut passer du temps ensemble) et le reste en remote si tu le souhaites (2 jours / semaine ou 1 semaine / mois).
  • Des bureaux très agréables à Bastille avec une salle de sport, un rooftop.
  • Cagnotte May : 1500 euros net/an (125 euros net/mois).
  • Swile pour les tickets restaurants à hauteur 10€ / jour.
  • Gymlib, pour faire du sport;
  • Politique de 7 semaines de congés payés / RTT.
  • Leeto, pour des centaines d’avantages et de réductions, grâce à notre CSE.
  • Mutuelle : SideCare.
  • 50% du pass Navigo ou Veligo.
  • Mac ou windows? Tu choisis, on veut que tu te sentes à l’aise.

Rémunération :

Package annuel brut entre 43 200 euros et 47 200 euros annuel brut (fixe + cagnotte May), selon nos grilles de rémunération en interne.

Cette fourchette est donnée à titre indicatif : le positionnement précis sera défini en fonction de ton expérience, de tes compétences et de ton adéquation au poste, afin de garantir cohérence et équité interne.

🎤 Processus de recrutement

Notre philosophie : un processus de recrutement équilibré, pensé pour te projeter dans ton futur quotidien de travail.

  • 30 minutes de screening pour comprendre ton parcours et tes aspirations.
  • Une première étude de cas pour évaluer tes compétences, et approfondir ton expérience.
  • Une seconde étude de cas pour te mettre en situation face à des enjeux client concrets.
  • Un entretien Values fit pour s’assurer mutuellement que notre cadre et nos valeurs te conviendront.
  • Offre et reverse interview: l’opportunité pour toi de nous poser toutes les questions importantes pour prendre ta décision.

Entre chaque étape tu as un feedback et si besoin nous organisons également des échanges informels avec l’équipe.

Poste ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As Harvey scales its pre-sales function across EMEA, we are hiring a Legal Engineer Manager to lead and grow the team in Paris. This role exists to provide senior leadership and strategic direction to a team of Legal Engineers who sit at the heart of Harvey's commercial motion - bringing legal credibility, product expertise, and consultative support to law firm and in-house prospects.

Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective.

Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.

Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Legal Engineers, setting clear performance expectations and building a high-trust, high-output team culture

  • Own the quality and consistency of Harvey's pre-sales legal engineering function, ensuring demos, discovery conversations, and deal support are delivered to the highest standard

  • Partner closely with Account Executives and GTM leadership to prioritise pipeline, develop deal strategy, and support conversion on complex or strategic opportunities

  • Engage with lawyers at prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges

  • Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

  • Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

  • Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.

LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

 

VOTRE ROLE


En lien direct avec le studio de création, vous traduisez les croquis et les intentions du directeur artistique en volumes et en premiers patronages. Vous êtes garant(e) de la silhouette, des proportions et du bien-aller des pièces de la Maison.

 

VOS MISSIONS

  • Interpréter les croquis et les références du studio pour créer les patronages
  • Travailler les volumes en coupe à plat et en moulage
  • Réaliser et modifier les toiles
  • Suivre le montage des prototypes avec l'atelier
  • Animer les essayages et proposer des ajustements de coupe et de proportions
  • Faire évoluer les patronages jusqu'à la validation finale
  • Transmettre au bureau d'études des modèles et des dossiers techniques complets
 

VOTRE PROFIL

  • Formation en modélisme (BTS, DMA, ESMOD, AICP, Chambre Syndicale ou équivalent)
  • 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en tant que modéliste dans une maison de luxe ou de prêt-à-porter haut de gamme
  • Spécialisation flou et/ou tailleur, avec une bonne connaissance des matières associées (soie, crêpe, lainages, tissus structurés…)
  • Maîtrise de la coupe à plat et du moulage ; la connaissance d'un logiciel de CAO est un plus
  • Sensibilité créative et bonne compréhension de l'univers de la Maison
  • Sens du volume, du détail et du bien-aller
  • Capacité à échanger avec le studio et à tenir les délais de collection
 
Ce poste est basé dans le 8ème arrondissement de Paris

Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

VOTRE ROLE

Rattaché(e) à la Responsable Tissus, le/la Chargé(e) de Sourcing et Développement Textile Senior assure le sourcing et le développement des matières textiles pour les collections de prêt-à-porter Homme et Femme JACQUEMUS.

Grâce à son expertise textile, sa sensibilité produit et sa connaissance du marché, elle/il identifie les matières adaptées à la vision créative de la Maison et accompagne leur développement jusqu’à leur transmission aux équipes Achats.

VOS MISSIONS

1. Sourcing textile

  • Rechercher et sourcer les matières en accord avec les besoins des collections.
  • Présenter régulièrement les sélections à la Responsable Tissus et aux équipes Design.
  • Préparer et animer les rendez-vous fournisseurs.
  • Participer aux salons textiles à Paris et à Milan.
  • Assurer la gestion et l’organisation de la tissuthèque.

2. Développement textile

  • Lancer et suivre les développements textiles : lab dips, impressions, jacquards et développements spécifiques.
  • Assurer le suivi avec les fournisseurs et les techniciens des usines textiles.
  • Garantir le respect des délais et des priorités de développement.
  • Organiser la passation des développements à la Chargée des Achats Tissus.
  • Assurer l’archivage et la traçabilité des développements.

3. Coordination et pilotage

  • Élaborer et suivre le planning de sourcing et de développement avec les équipes.
  • Vérifier les racks et les boards tissus avec la Chargée des Achats Tissus.
  • Réaliser un point hebdomadaire avec les équipes Design et les Chefs de Produit.
  • Contribuer à la mise en place du plan de collection matières et au suivi de son cadrage.
  • Suivre le budget de développement textile.

VOTRE PROFIL

  • Minimum 4 ans d’expérience en sourcing et développement textile.
  • Expertise des matières et bonne connaissance des fournisseurs et techniciens textiles.
  • Forte sensibilité produit et intérêt marqué pour l’univers du textile.
  • Curiosité, proactivité et sens des priorités.

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Senior Account Executive to grow our footprint across France. You’ll be at the forefront of introducing Tandem’s clinician copilot to providers, partners, and health systems - shaping how we scale across France

This is a pivotal role where you’ll forge high-impact partnerships across the care ecosystem, from provider networks and EHR vendors to resellers and health insurers. You’ll act as a market expert, relationship builder, and operator all in one.

What you will do

  • Identify, initiate, and manage key relationships across the healthcare landscape in France.

  • Represent Tandem externally in meetings, events, and conferences, positioning us as a trusted digital health partner.

  • Bring the voice of the market back into Tandem, sharing insights that inform product development, regulatory priorities, and local go-to-market strategy.

  • Help build the customer success and support infrastructure that ensures our partners thrive with Tandem.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience with healthcare partnerships, sales, or business development - ideally in health-tech, med-tech, with familiarity of the hospital ecosystem

  • A strong track record of closing strategic partnerships in complex, regulated environments with providers, EHRs, or pharmaceutical companies.

  • Deep knowledge of the French hospital ecosystem - from payors and providers to health IT vendors and regional nuances.

  • A strong local network and ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholder groups.

  • Comfortable navigating clinical, commercial, and technical conversations.

  • Fluent in French and English, with excellent communication skills.

  • Independent operator with the ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams.

  • Passion for improving healthcare delivery through thoughtful, impactful innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with or selling into EHR providers, health systems, or care delivery platforms.

  • Background in medtech, digital health, healthcare

  • Familiarity with EU/French regulatory and compliance environments.

  • Experience in startup or high-growth environments, especially launching new markets.


What we offer

  • Competitive salary, reviewed as you grow, plus stock options

  • 30 days of holiday

  • Paid parental leave

  • €1,000 annual health & wellbeing budget, plus mental-health support whenever you need it

  • A real learning budget and internal growth paths - build your career without leaving Tandem

  • Fully AI native company - let our agents do the grunt work

  • Two company off-sites a year, plus a team budget for the things that bring you closer

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a full-time role based in Paris, France. You’ll travel regularly - either to meet clinicians around France or to collaborate with our team in Stockholm.


How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  2. First interview with our Country Director in France

  3. Working Day - Join us in the Paris office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About the Role

This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses.

You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound.

Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies.

What You'll Do

Own the numbers

• Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation.

• Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance.

• Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report.

• Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations.

• Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO.

Drive the growth agenda

• Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them.

• Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business.

• Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent.

• Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control.

• Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI.

• Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region.

Who We're Looking For

• An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output.

• Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it.

• A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent).

• 5+ years in Business Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering.

• Ability to lead and build a team of regional finance specialists.

• Comfort operating in a decentralised, multi-entity, PE-backed environment - you'll manage stakeholders across businesses at very different stages of maturity.

• Fluent in English and French; effective communicator at every level of an organisation, from bookkeeper to CEO.

• Ideally, a background in fast-growing technology or SaaS companies.

• Willingness to travel occasionally.

What We Offer

• Attractive salary package with performance-based bonus.

• Remote flexibility.

• A collaborative team culture based on respect, ownership, and trust.

• Access to international experts within the Everfield ecosystem - accelerate your personal and professional growth.

• Regular team events and company celebrations.

Interview Process

Here's what to expect and who you'll meet during the recruitment process:

• First interview with Talent Acquisition Manager (0.5 h)

• Second interview with Hiring Manager (1.0 h)

• Third interview with Group Finance representatives (1.0 h)

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision is made based on skills, qualifications and experiences.

We look forward to receiving your application!

About the Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Kpler, you will play a key role in developing and deploying predictive models that power our global commodity, energy, and maritime intelligence platforms. Working closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product teams, you will bridge the gap between machine learning experimentation and production-grade software delivery. Your work will directly transform complex data flows into real-time, actionable insights that help world-leading trading firms, industrial leaders, and analysts make critical decisions.

  • Architect and deploy ML pipelines: Design, build, and maintain production-grade machine learning workflows and microservices for power market forecasting and electricity grid modeling.

  • Bridge research and engineering: Transition statistical and machine learning prototypes from initial experimentation into scalable, production-ready Python applications.

  • Manage time-series and event data systems: Design and optimize database schemas in PostgreSQL to handle high-throughput time-series data, event streams, and normalization routines.

  • Implement robust MLOps practices: Establish automated model training, backtesting, evaluation, tuning, and feature/model versioning standards across deployments.
