Berlin, 35-40 hours per week, starting immediatly

Do you want to work and help shape the world of work? Then join us and become part of a purpose-driven team working towards a fair and sustainable world of work.

We are INES Analytics – a passionate software start-up in the heart of Berlin. Our mission: to make social sustainability measurable and to support companies in creating fair working conditions.

To drive our mission forward, we’re looking for you: a committed individual to strengthen our team.

A growing team, a clear mission and the chance to help shape real social change through your work – data-driven, practical and forward-looking.

Tasks

You'll own the backend technically and be the go-to person for architecture and infrastructure. You'll write code yourself, help the team grow, and set the technical direction. Together with us, you'll grow into the CTO role.

In Detail:

  • Own the backend (Python/Django): architecture, code quality, scalability and maintainability
  • Design and evolve REST APIs and integrate external systems
  • Build authentication and SSO (e.g. OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML)
  • Design and run asynchronous processing and background jobs
  • Keep the system fast and scalable as we grow: profiling, query optimization, caching
  • Build a strong testing culture with automated unit, integration and end-to-end tests
  • Review code and pull requests, and set shared engineering standards
  • Mentor junior developers and support their growth
  • Shape and improve reliable deployment, release and CI/CD processes
  • Run and optimize our cloud infrastructure on AWS, containerized with Docker and managed as Infrastructure as Code
  • Set up monitoring, logging and alerting so issues are caught before customers notice them
  • Write and maintain clear technical documentation on architecture, APIs and runbooks
  • Build security and data protection (GDPR) into our architecture and code
  • Work closely with product, design and founders, and bring technical input to the roadmap

Requirements

The following qualifications and experiences are required

* Experience as a tech lead or in a first leadership role

* Several Years of backend development experience with Python and Django

  • Strong PostgreSQL skills (data modeling, performance tuning, migrations)
  • Experience designing and building REST APIs (e.g. Django REST Framework)
  • Hands-on experience with authentication/SSO and integrating external systems
  • Experience with asynchronous task processing
  • A proven track record of improving performance and scaling systems under growing load
  • Solid testing practice (e.g. pytest) and a belief that well-tested code ships faster
  • Confident with Linux, deployment and cloud infrastructure, especially AWS (incl. S3), nginx and Gunicorn
  • Experience with Docker and Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
  • Experience with monitoring and observability
  • A good understanding of SaaS architecture, security and data protection
  • You write clear documentation and value it as part of the work
  • Experience with code reviews and a genuine interest in mentoring others
  • Strong communication skills: you can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical people and make decisions together with them
  • A startup mindset: you're pragmatic, take ownership and handle ambiguity and changing priorities well
  • The drive to grow into a leadership role
  • Fluent English and / or German

Even if you don’t tick all the boxes perfectly, we’d love to hear from you!

Nice to have:

  • Previous startup experience
  • Experience with compliance frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2):

Benefits

  • Real ownership and a clear path to CTO
  • A small, motivated team where decisions happen quickly
  • A Job with Purpose: Together with our team, you’ll lay the foundation for a future free of discrimination for all employees in companies
  • Flexible work hours with a portion of mobile work
  • Direct access to the founding team instead of anonymous corporate structures
  • Real responsibility from day one—your work directly contributes to the product
  • Insights into building a startup in the field of pay equity and compliance tech
  • Deutschlandticket

We don’t have a never-ending application process. Just send us your CV and a short cover letter so we can find out a bit more about you. If it looks like a good fit, we’ll have a little task for you and invite you to a relaxed online chat. And if we hit it off, we’ll take it further: welcome to our Berlin office – complete with coffee, a great team atmosphere and maybe even a quick game of table tennis to round things off.

We also embrace diversity within our organisation and are actively committed to equal opportunities. We’re therefore particularly keen to hear from people with different perspectives – regardless of gender, background, sexual orientation, age, disability or religious affiliation.

data.description:
Deine Mission

Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen.

Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde.
Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben.

Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen.

Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch.

Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einem Kalender.

Konkret:

  • ANRUFEN, NICHT ABTELEFONIEREN: Du stellst das neue Produkt bei Bestandspartnern vor. Nicht Skript vom Blatt, sondern ein Gespräch, das beim Gegenüber ankommt.
  • DEN PITCH WEITERENTWICKELN: Du merkst, welcher Einstieg funktioniert und welcher Einwand immer wieder kommt. Du behältst das nicht für dich, du änderst den Leitfaden.
  • ZUHÖREN UND ZURÜCKSPIELEN: Was Partner am Telefon sagen, ist die ehrlichste Rückmeldung, die wir zum Produkt bekommen. Du bist die direkteste Leitung dorthin und nutzt sie.
  • BEZIEHUNG STATT KONTAKTLISTE: Du übernimmst einen festen Kreis von Partnern. Nach drei Monaten kennen die deinen Namen, nicht unsere Rufnummer.
  • SAUBER NACHHALTEN: Was besprochen wurde, landet nachvollziehbar in Hubspot, damit das Team damit weiterarbeiten kann.


Dein Talent

  • SUSTAINABILITY: Du interessierst dich sehr für Klimaschutz und Nachhaltigkeit und willst mehr darüber lernen und bewegen

  • WORKING STUDENT: Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium und bringst idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrungen mit, zum Beispiel durch Praktika oder ehrenamtliches Engagement

  • AM TELEFON ZU HAUSE: Du hast schon mal jemanden am Telefon von etwas überzeugt — im Job, im Verein, im Nebenjob, egal.

  • AUF DEN PUNKT, OHNE KALT ZU WIRKEN: Du sagst in drei Sätzen, wofür andere zehn brauchen, und klingst dabei trotzdem wie ein Mensch. Handwerksbetriebe haben keine Zeit für Marketing-Sprache und merken sofort, wenn jemand welche spricht.

  • ZUVERLÄSSIG, NICHT VERHANDELBAR: Zugesagter Rückruf am Donnerstag heißt Donnerstag. Das ist bei uns Grundvoraussetzung, keine Stärke.

  • DU BRINGST WAS ZURÜCK: Nach fünfzig Gesprächen hast du eine Meinung dazu, was funktioniert. Du sagst sie, ohne dass wir danach fragen müssen.

  • DEUTSCH AUF MUTTERSPRACHNIVEAU: Unsere Partner sind deutsche Handwerksbetriebe. Das Gespräch läuft auf Deutsch, inklusive Zwischentöne und Dialekt am anderen Ende.

  • MINDESTENS 6 MONATE ZEIT: Kürzer lohnt sich für keinen von uns beiden. Bis du richtig gut in diesen Gesprächen bist, vergehen Wochen.


Unser Angebot

Wachstum & Kultur

Werde Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur fachlich durchstartet, sondern aktiv eine gesunde und nachhaltige Unternehmenskultur lebt. Bei uns zählt das Miteinander genauso viel wie der Erfolg.

Impact & Awareness

Deine Stimme hat Gewicht, im Büro und darüber hinaus. Neben deinem regulären Urlaub bekommst du zusätzliche freie Tage für Klimaaktivismus, Demos oder Projekte, die dir am Herzen liegen.

Flexibilität & Vertrauen

Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag nach deinem Rhythmus. Nutze unsere Flexdays, um mobil zu arbeiten – egal ob von zu Hause oder unterwegs innerhalb Deutschlands, immer in Absprache mit deinem Team.

Extra Benefits für dich

Wir machen deinen Alltag einfacher: Du bekommst einen flexiblen Bonus, den du nach Lust und Laune für Dinge einsetzen kannst, die dir Freude machen – ob Fitness, Kultur oder kleine Extras.

Verpflegung & Wohlbefinden

Wenn der Arbeitstag mal länger wird, sorgen wir dafür, dass niemand hungrig bleibt. Bestell dir über Wolt eine Mahlzeit direkt ins Büro – easy und lecker.

Community & Spirit

Wir verändern die Welt – und verlieren dabei nie den Spaß. Freu dich auf regelmäßige Offsites, Teamabende und unser legendäres „Bees & Beers“ als perfekten Ausgleich zu unserer Mission.

Was du bei uns machen wirst:

Wie bringt man Menschen dazu, sich freiwillig mit ihrer Steuererklärung zu beschäftigen?

Genau das ist deine Aufgabe.

Als Performance Creative Strategist bei Zasta entwickelst du Ideen, Hooks und Kampagnen, die aus einem komplexen Finanzthema relevante und unterhaltsame Werbung machen – und gleichzeitig messbar performen.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Paid Social, insbesondere Meta und TikTok. Gleichzeitig hast du die Möglichkeit, erfolgreiche Social-First-Ansätze auf TV zu übertragen und den Kanal gemeinsam mit uns neu zu denken.

Dabei bekommst du viel konzeptionellen Freiraum: Du entwickelst neue Creative Angles, hinterfragst bestehende Ansätze und findest über Daten, Zielgruppen-Insights und Testing heraus, welche Botschaften wirklich funktionieren.

  • Zielgruppen wirklich verstehen: Du analysierst Zielgruppen, ihre Bedürfnisse und ihre Mediennutzung. Du weißt, wie sich Botschaften je nach Kanal und Funnel-Stufe unterscheiden müssen – und setzt genau dort an.
  • Brücke zwischen Data & Kreativität sein: Du arbeitest eng mit Performance-Marketing, Data & Kreativ-Agenturen zur Ableitung und Optimierung von Creatives anhand von KPIs zusammen und übersetzt das in neue kreative Ansätze.
  • TV neu denken: Du hast Lust, TV nicht als verstaubten Kanal zu sehen, sondern als Spielfeld für starke, moderne Markenkommunikation, die klare Performance bringt. Du bringst frische Ideen ein und denkst TV konsequent aus der Social-Logik heraus.
  • Testing & Learnings vorantreiben: Du denkst in Iterationen, entwickelst Testing-Frameworks für Creatives und sorgst dafür, dass Learnings systematisch zurück in neue Konzepte fließen.


Was du idealerweise mitbringst:

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrungen im Bereich Creative Strategy, Creative Conception, Art Direction oder Kampagnenentwicklung. Idealerweise warst du vorher in einem digitalen Performance-Umfeld tätig.

  • Du bist neugierig, probierst Dinge aus und hast Lust, Konventionen zu hinterfragen. Du denkst nicht nur in Slides, sondern auch in konkreten Umsetzungen und setzt Ideen proaktiv um.
  • Für die interne und externe Kommunikation sprichst du Deutsch auf C1-Level und bist sicher in der Nutzung gängiger englischer Marketing- und Strategy-Begriffe.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau

Was du bei uns machen wirst:

TL;DR

Zasta ist die führende Steuer-App in den deutschen App Stores (schau selbst auf deinem Handy in der Kategorie Finanzen nach). 

Wir bauen kein Unternehmen über Headcount auf. Unsere Teams bestehen aus erfahrenen Expert:innen mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem klaren Anspruch an Qualität und Geschwindigkeit.

Wir suchen einen Chief of Staff mit außergewöhnlich hohem Drive und analytischer Stärke, der direkt mit unserem CEO an den wichtigsten strategischen Themen von Zasta arbeitet.

  • End-to-End Ownership: Von Analyse und Business Case über Partnerverhandlung und Scoping bis zu Go-live und messbarem Ergebnis.

  • Top-Profil: Sehr starker akademischer Track Record und typischerweise 3–8 Jahre relevante Erfahrung – z. B. Strategy Consulting + Operator-Rolle, Founders' Office oder General Management.

  • Business-relevante Projekte: Neue Geschäftsmodelle, Partnerschaften, Marketing Channels, regulatorische Themen, Markterweiterungen und andere strategische Initiativen.

  • Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau ist aufgrund unseres regulierten Steuerumfelds zwingend erforderlich.

  • Starkes Gehalt + VSOP, ein klarer Entwicklungspfad in eine operative Leadership-Rolle bei Zasta (wenn dein Weg dich stattdessen zur eigenen Gründung führt, unterstützen wir dich gerne mit einem Angel-Ticket).

Du bist für relevante strategische Themen von der ersten Idee bis zum messbaren Business Impact verantwortlich.

Achtung: Das ist keine klassische Stabs-, PMO- oder Koordinationsrolle.

Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein, schaffst Struktur, entwickelst Business Cases, identifizierst und verhandelst mit Partner:innen und treibst die Umsetzung gemeinsam mit Product, Tech, Marketing und Operations bis zum Go-live.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Dinge baut und ins Ziel bringt, anstatt nur Entscheidungsvorlagen zu erarbeiten.

Deine Verantwortung

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CEO und eng mit dem Management Team an strategisch relevanten Initiativen. Deine Themen sind keine Side Projects. Sie bewegen relevante Line-Items in unserem Business Plan.

Je nach Projekt bedeutet das:

  • neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten identifizieren, auf Machbarkeit prüfen und umsetzen

  • komplexe, unstrukturierte Probleme in klare Hypothesen, Entscheidungen und Workstreams übersetzen

  • Business Cases und Economics entwickeln und kritisch challengen

  • externe Partner:innen identifizieren, bewerten und kommerzielle Konditionen verhandeln

  • gemeinsam mit Product, Tech, Marketing und Operations MVPs konzipieren und umsetzen

Wir messen dich nicht daran, wie gut deine Slides sind, sondern daran, ob du reale Probleme löst und messbaren Business Impact schaffst.

Zwei beispielhafte ProjekteEinen neuen Geschäftsbereich aufbauen

Rund um das „Altersvorsorgedepot“ entstehen in Deutschland neue Marktchancen.

Du bewertest, welche Rolle Zasta darin spielen sollte – von einer Affiliate-Partnerschaft bis zu einer tief integrierten Produktlösung.

Markt & Strategie → Business Case → Partner Sourcing → Verhandlung → MVP → Tech-Integration → Go-live

Du entwickelst die Economics, identifizierst geeignete Partner:innen, führst Verhandlungen, bewertest regulatorische und operative Anforderungen und bringst die gewählte Lösung gemeinsam mit Product und Tech in unser Produkt. Ein sauberes „Nein“ ist für uns genauso wertvoll wie ein Go-live – wenn die Economics oder Rahmenbedingungen nicht stimmen.

Einen neuen Marketingkanal erschließen

Wir wollen beispielsweise testen, ob sich Out-of-Home zu einem skalierbaren Performance-Marketing-Kanal für Zasta entwickeln kann (und ja: Wir meinen Performance, nicht nur Brand).

Du entwickelst Business Case und Testsetup, bewertest Anbieter und Inventar, verhandelst Konditionen und bringst die Kampagne gemeinsam mit Marketing und Brand live. Wenn Lukas Podolski Teil des Test-Setups sein soll, bekommen wir auch das hin. Anschließend entscheiden wir anhand klarer KPIs: Scale, iterate or stop.

Weitere Projekte können neue Partnerschaften, Pricing, regulatorische Themen, operative Skalierung, M&A, neue Produkte, Vertriebskanäle, vollständig neue Geschäftsmodelle oder interne Strukturen betreffen.


Was du idealerweise mitbringst:

Wir suchen eine außergewöhnlich starke Kombination aus analytischer Exzellenz, Geschwindigkeit und Ownership.

Du bringst mit:

  • einen sehr guten akademischen Track Record und einen sehr guten Abschluss von einer führenden Universität

  • typischerweise 3–8 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung

  • außergewöhnlich starke analytische und strukturierte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten

  • die Fähigkeit, dich sehr schnell und tief in neue und komplexe Themen einzuarbeiten

  • sehr gutes quantitatives und kommerzielles Urteilsvermögen

  • Sicherheit im Umgang mit Gründer:innen, Senior Stakeholdern, Führungskräften und externen Partner:innen

  • einen sehr hohen Anspruch an Qualität und Geschwindigkeit sowie einen starken Bias for Action

Wenn du ein Problem siehst, wartest du nicht auf Zuständigkeiten. Du übernimmst Ownership, schaffst Klarheit und bringst die Lösung ins Ziel.

Exzellentes Deutsch ist zwingend erforderlich

Du sprichst Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte sprachlich präzise erfassen, formulieren und verhandeln.

Das ist für uns keine formale Anforderung: Zasta bewegt sich in einem stark regulierten Umfeld rund um Steuerberatung, Finanzprozesse und Verbraucherschutz. In vielen Fragestellungen kommt es auf juristische, steuerliche oder regulatorische Nuancen der deutschen Sprache an.

Du musst in der Lage sein, diese selbstständig zu verstehen, kritisch zu hinterfragen und präzise mit Steuerberater:innen, Partner:innen, Anwält:innen, Behörden und internen Teams zu kommunizieren.


Was wir dir bieten:

  • starkes Gehalt + VSOP

  • direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CEO und Management Team

  • außergewöhnlich viel Verantwortung und Entscheidungsspielraum

  • kurze Wege von einer guten Idee zur tatsächlichen Umsetzung

  • einen bewussten Entwicklungspfad in eine operative Leadership-Rolle bei Zasta

Wir suchen keinen Career Chief of Staff. Wir suchen einen zukünftigen Business Owner.

Im besten Fall übernimmst du nach dieser Rolle einen relevanten Teil des Unternehmens selbst – als Business Owner, VP oder in einer anderen Leadership-Funktion.

Und dein Weg muss nicht bei Zasta enden:

Wir würden uns freuen, wenn wir dich in einigen Jahren bei der Gründung deines eigenen Unternehmens mit einem Angel-Ticket unterstützen könnten.

data.description:
Our Mission

At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive in-ovo sex detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.

Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.

We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Mission

You'll work directly with our Head of Finance&HR and keep the people side of Omegga running while we scale. This is not a "help out where needed" working student role. You own recurring processes end to end, and you get real responsibility from week one.

  • Onboarding & Offboarding: Own the operational employee lifecycle. Prepare contracts and documents, coordinate equipment and accounts, run structured first days, and manage clean offboardings.

  • Personio: Keep our HR system the single source of truth. Maintain employee data, absences, digital personnel files, and documentation quality, and help us get more out of the tool than we do today.

  • Recruiting Support: Draft and publish job ads, keep our applicant tracking system clean, coordinate interview scheduling, and own candidate communication so no application goes unanswered.

  • Recruiting Day: Organize our candidate day end to end: invitations, agenda, materials, interviewer briefings, and on site coordination.

  • Internal Events: Plan and run internal formats, from team events to company offsite

  • Development Budget: Take ownership of our people development budget. Build the process and guideline from scratch with us, then run it: track requests and spend, support colleagues in finding the right trainings, and keep it transparent.

  • Performance & Review Process: Help us prepare the rollout of our company wide review cycle. You build templates, timelines and tooling, and drive the internal communication around it.

Your Profile

  • Enrolled student (Bachelor or Master), around 16 hours per week during the semester, more during breaks if you want to. We plan in weeks, not fixed days, so exams and lectures can be accommodated as long as recurring processes stay covered. Ideally for at least 12 months. Your field of study is open. Business, psychology, law or something entirely different. What matters is that you care how people work in a company, not which lecture hall you sit in.

  • Some practical experience in HR, recruiting or operations, ideally somewhere that moved fast. We don't need an HR certificate. We need structure and judgment.

  • You catch what others miss. The missing signature, the wrong start date, the empty field in Personio. In HR, sloppy data becomes someone's problem three months later.

  • Discretion is second nature. You handle contract and personnel data without ever making it a topic.

  • You'd rather fix a process than repeat it. New tools don't scare you (Personio, Ashby, Notion, Google Workspace), and manual work twice in a row makes you build something better. You close loops without being asked. You structure your own week, decide when a decision is needed, and you push back when someone tries to bend a process.


Not ticking every box? That's okay. One exception to the above: German at C1 level or above is required for this role.
If this role excites you and you bring most of what we've described, we want to hear from you.

Why Us

Mission & Technical Challenge: At Omegga, you work on problems that are both technically demanding and globally relevant. We build deep-tech solutions with real-world impact, pushing the boundaries of what's currently possible.

Real Ownership: You won't be doing research tasks on the side. You run processes that the whole company touches, and you'll see the results of your work in how the whole team experiences Omegga.

Work Environment: Located in Munich's Werksviertel, we combine a focused, high-performance culture with flexibility. Most of our work happens in the office, remote work is possible depending on the task.

Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delinea’s leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle – across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities – including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines – assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
 

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Summary:

Delinea is seeking a talented Technical Support Engineer to join our Global Technical Support team, providing world-class support to our customers.

 

Our ideal candidate is a responsible and motivated self-starter with a desire to learn modern technologies and concepts and solve technical questions.

 

This individual should have significant technical knowledge and understanding of IT, networking, and cyber security concepts, combined with the ability to troubleshoot technical customer issues and maintain a clear, professional, and efficient customer interaction.

This position reports directly to the Technical Support team manager.

 

This role includes participation in a shared on-call rotation, which may require availability outside standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, to support production issues and escalations. On-call responsibilities are distributed across the team on a rotating basis.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Provide post-sale technical support to customers and partners

  • Assess and document reported customer issues

  • Formulate and communicate resolution plans

  • Gather necessary information and resources

  • Investigate and reproduce case scenarios

  • Provide clear customer responses and document corrective actions

 

What You'll Need:

  • 1-2 years of proven relevant professional experience as a technical support agent or its equivalent

  • In depth knowledge and experience in at least some of the following:

  • IT and System administration

  • Networking and data transport and encryption

  • Cloud infrastructure, Machine, network and services virtualization

  • Security concepts and methodologies

  • Relational databases and SQL language proficiency and .NET applications are a bonus

 

What Else:

  • Troubleshooting and problem deconstruction

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills

  • Ability to work diverse, international, customer and team environments

  • Trustworthy, self-motivated, and reliable

  • Accountability, transparency, and ownership

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

  • Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

  • Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

ZEAL Network SE is a leading international provider of online lottery and prize draw products, operating for over 20 years with brands like LOTTO24 and Tipp24. As Germany’s largest digital lottery operator and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, we are passionate about creating exciting and innovative ways for people to win.

7days Performance is one of the newest brands to join the ZEAL Group and a well-established name in the UK prize competition market. The brand gives customers the chance to win high-value prizes, with a strong focus on performance and luxury cars, alongside cash and other exciting prizes.

Now part of ZEAL, 7days Performance is entering an exciting new chapter, combining its strong UK brand and community with ZEAL’s experience, technology and ambition for growth. It’s an exciting time to join the team and play a part in shaping what comes next for the brand.

Location: Norwich-based, with regular in-office presence (willingness to travel to London, Manchester, and Hamburg as required)

The role:

In this role, you will own and develop core People & Culture operations across three UK locations, creating consistent and scalable HR processes while supporting the needs of each local team. You’ll manage everything from payroll and HR systems to employee relations and performance management, acting as a trusted partner to both employees and people managers.

Your responsibilities

  • Unify and administer HRIS across all three locations.

  • Independently run payroll for all three UK entities.

  • Build and own administrative HR processes (contracts, onboarding, off-boarding, employee files, compliance) and policies from scratch, tailored to local needs and aligned with group standards.

  • Roll out and advise people managers and employees on performance management, individual cases, and all People & Culture topics.

  • Mediate and provide supervision in interpersonal or employment-related conflict situations.

  • Brief and coach people managers on leadership topics and HR processes.

  • Act as the main point of contact for all employee belonging topics and processes.

  • Work hands-on day to day, with regular presence across all three sites and the Hamburg headquarters.

What you offer us:

  • Several years of experience as an HR/People & Culture Generalist, ideally within the UK market.

  • Solid knowledge of UK payroll and UK employment law.

  • Experience building HR structures and processes in growing or newly integrated organisations (e.g. post-M&A, in start-ups or scale-ups).

  • Hands-on experience implementing or unifying HRIS systems.

  • Confident handling of performance management processes, plus experience in mediation and conflict resolution.

  • Strong hands-on mentality, self-initiative, and enjoyment of building structures from scratch.

  • Strong communication and advisory skills with managers and employees at all levels.

  • Willingness to travel between London, Manchester, and Hamburg.

  • Fluent English, spoken and written.

What we offer you:

  • A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company.

  • A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact.

  • Pension scheme with employer matching contributions of up to 7.5%.

  • 25 days annual leave plus UK bank holidays.

  • Enhanced sick pay after probation.

  • Employee Assistance Programme with access to mental health support and 24/7 GP services.

data.description:
The R&D team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organization that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that automates entity resolution, optimizes data labeling pipelines, and creates predictive models that identify illicit patterns before they escalate.

Our data and solutions have been used to solve some of the world's most high-profile criminal cases and grow consumer access to cryptocurrency safely. Now, by pairing the industry's most trusted blockchain data with agents that reason, investigate, and act, we help our customers scale their workflows as the cryptocurrency economy becomes increasingly mainstream.

Chainalysis data has helped solve some of the world’s highest-profile criminal and national-security cases and made it safer for people everywhere to access crypto. The Global Intelligence Team produces the attribution at the heart of that data — connecting on-chain activity to the real-world entities behind it, across the global crypto ecosystem. It’s the intelligence data moat beneath every Chainalysis product, and what investigators, sanctions authorities, and national-security agencies rely on to follow the money and disrupt threats.

Few threats test that mission harder than North Korea and China. Through Lazarus Group, the DPRK has stolen billions in crypto — via exchange and DeFi hacks and IT-worker schemes — to fund its weapons program, then laundered it through mixers, cross-chain bridges, and Chinese OTC networks. China, in turn, sits at the center of global crypto money laundering — from guarantee marketplaces and underground banking to scam compounds, fentanyl vendors, and cartel-linked laundering. The two are deeply intertwined, and making that activity visible on-chain is one of the most consequential problems in crypto intelligence today.

As our DPRK- and China-focused intelligence analyst — the team’s subject-matter expert on North Korea and China — you’ll own that problem end to end. This is a depth role: while our analysts cover the breadth of the crypto-services ecosystem, you’ll go deep on a single, high-stakes domain — becoming the person, inside Chainalysis and increasingly across the industry, who understands how DPRK and Chinese actors use crypto and can prove it on-chain. You’ll own the attribution for their crypto footprint, map how these networks actually operate, turn that into finished intelligence customers act on, and be the expert voice representing Chainalysis on DPRK and China crypto threats.

Who you’ll work with

You’ll join a fast-moving, globally distributed team — analysts, threat-domain SMEs, data scientists, and engineers — collaborating across time zones, async and in real time. We move fast, hold each other to a high bar, and back each other up across regions. As the DPRK & China SME, you’ll be the single point of depth for the domain and a force multiplier for everyone working adjacent to it.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own DPRK & China attribution end to end — the threat-actor entities, their definitions, and the accounts, addresses, and infrastructure they operate: Lazarus Group and DPRK state-sponsored theft and laundering, DPRK IT-worker networks, Chinese-language OTC and underground-banking networks, guarantee marketplaces (e.g., Huione-style platforms), scam-compound and pig-butchering laundering infrastructure, fentanyl and precursor vendors, and Chinese money-laundering organizations.

  • Lead the attribution response to DPRK- and China-related sanctions events — when OFAC or allied authorities designate DPRK actors, exchange-hacking units, or Chinese laundering networks, drive the rapid, high-visibility on-chain attribution that turns those designations into coverage in our data, often against the clock.

  • Map the networks on-chain — trace how stolen and illicit funds move through mixers, cross-chain bridges, no-KYC swaps, OTC brokers, and off-ramps, following DPRK hack proceeds into and through Chinese laundering infrastructure, and keep that picture current as they adapt to pressure.

  • Produce finished intelligence — advisory notes, customer and partner briefings, and contributions to flagship publications (the Crypto Crime Report and beyond) that make DPRK theft/laundering and Chinese money laundering legible and actionable.

  • Be the named external expert — represent Chainalysis on DPRK and China crypto threats at conferences, on panels, with the press, and in briefings to public- and private-sector partners.

  • Help set the DPRK & China collection agenda — surface what data we need on these networks and feed those requirements into our collection process and priority intelligence requirements; you direct collection for the domain, but it runs through the team’s apparatus and prioritization, not you alone.

  • Translate typologies into detection — turn what you learn about DPRK and Chinese methods into guidance that our products and our customers can operationalize.

  • Build with AI — design and tune the automation that scales your analysis and the team’s, and handle the hard cases automation can’t.

  • Level up the team — raise the bar on DPRK, China, and money-laundering tradecraft broadly, and partner closely with analysts, other SMEs, data science, and engineering.

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Deep, demonstrable DPRK and/or China expertise — real command of DPRK state-sponsored crypto operations (Lazarus Group, exchange and bridge hacks, IT-worker schemes) and/or Chinese-language money laundering, OTC and underground banking, guarantee marketplaces, and organized-crime finance. This is the core of the role, and we’ll expect you to show it.

  • On-chain tracing ability against DPRK/China targets — direct experience following DPRK hack laundering or Chinese OTC/laundering networks on-chain, or deep DPRK/China threat-finance expertise paired with proven blockchain-tracing skill you can bring to bear here from day one.

  • A national-security or threat-finance background — intelligence, sanctions, counter-threat-finance, or investigations, from the IC, Treasury/OFAC, law enforcement, the military, a think tank or research institution, or private-sector CTF/sanctions work.

  • Regional fluency — a strong grasp of the DPRK and Chinese illicit-finance ecosystems and regional money-laundering flows. Mandarin and/or Korean language ability is a significant plus.

  • Elite potential and a proven track record — exceptional aptitude, judgment, and work ethic; you’ve led hard problems end to end and you raise everyone around you.

  • Excellent writing and communication — this is an outward-facing expert role; your intelligence has to land with analysts, customers, and senior audiences alike.

  • AI-forward instincts — you build automation to scale your work and others’, not just use it.

  • Comfort working with data; blockchain forensics experience strongly preferred.

  • 5+ years of relevant analytic, intelligence, or threat-finance experience for a Senior hire; 8+ years and recognized domain authority for a Staff hire.

You might also have:

  • Mandarin and/or Korean language ability.

  • Direct experience with OFAC sanctions, designations, or the designation process — especially involving DPRK or Chinese entities.

  • A record of published research or public speaking on DPRK crypto theft, Lazarus Group, or Chinese money laundering.

  • Familiarity with cross-chain bridge and mixer laundering, guarantee marketplaces (e.g., Huione-style platforms), or Chinese OTC and underground-banking networks.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. About Keyrock

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

What we are looking for

We are seeking a Head of Risk to own and develop the Firm’s risk function end-to-end. This is a senior leadership role with direct accountability for the design, implementation and enforcement of a Firm-wide risk framework across all activities.

The role requires strong quantitative risk expertise and the ability to apply rigorous methodologies to complex, real-time markets across both traditional finance and digital assets. The successful candidate will co-design the firm’s risk architecture with the COO and CIO, covering data, analytics and real-time risk aggregation.

You will have full oversight of risk across trading (spot and derivatives), treasury and investments, including exposures across CeFi and DeFi environments. This includes defining risk appetite, implementing advanced risk metrics and ensuring disciplined risk-taking across the organization.

We are looking for a leader who sets the standard, challenges the business and enforces a strong risk culture, while enabling the firm to scale.

 
 

Role description

Quantitative Risk Framework: Develop and maintain a quantitative risk framework grounded in modern risk theory (e.g. market, credit, liquidity and systemic risk modelling), leveraging concepts such as tail risk, extreme value theory, dependence structures and stress testing

Firm-wide Risk System Architecture: Co-design and implement the Firm-wide risk management system in close collaboration with the COO and CIO, including data architecture, risk aggregation layers, real-time monitoring capabilities and reporting infrastructure across all business lines.

Cross-Asset & Cross-Infrastructure Risk Integration: Build an integrated risk view across centralized and decentralized venues, covering exchange risk, counterparty risk, smart contract risk, collateral efficiency and liquidity fragmentation.

Advanced Risk Modelling & Metrics: Define and implement advanced risk metrics (VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress scenarios, liquidity-adjusted risk, concentration risk) and ensure their consistent application across trading, treasury and investment activities.

Is plus: TradFi ↔ Crypto Risk Translation: Translate traditional financial risk methodologies into crypto-native environments, adapting models to account for 24/7 markets, fragmented liquidity, funding dynamics, on-chain transparency and new failure modes (e.g. oracle risk, protocol risk).

 
 

Background and Experience

Quantitative Risk Expertise: Strong foundation in quantitative risk management, including hands-on experience with market risk, credit risk and liquidity risk modelling, ideally aligned with frameworks such as those presented in Quantitative Risk Management (McNeil, Frey, Embrechts).

Modelling & Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to design and implement risk models, including tail risk estimation, scenario analysis, stress testing frameworks and dependence modelling across asset classes.

System Design & Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven experience in designing or co-designing firm-wide risk systems, working closely with technology (CIO) and operations (COO) to translate risk requirements into scalable infrastructure.

TradFi + Crypto Hybrid Experience: Experience operating at the intersection of traditional financial markets and digital assets (CeFi and/or DeFi), with a strong understanding of differences in market structure, risk transmission and infrastructure.

Crypto-Specific Risk Understanding: Practical knowledge of crypto-specific risks, including exchange/custodian risk, smart contract risk, protocol risk, funding/basis dynamics and collateral management in both centralized and decentralized environments.

Competences and personality

  • Strong drive and proactivity to continuously strengthen the risk management in a fast-growing financial institution

  • The candidate reports to the COO but this is not a reporting role, but a quantitative risk management system-building role.

Our recruitment philosophy


We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the role

At Perk, we believe in empowering cross-functional teams that drive exceptional results for our customers and the company. We’re transforming how work gets done by eliminating tedious manual processes in travel, spend, and events.

As a Product Manager at Perk, you will play a pivotal role in driving innovation by identifying opportunities, shaping product strategy, and leading execution. You’ll work closely with customers, stakeholders, and lean product development teams to build best in class solutions for our users. We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to join the team and own the Billing product area.


Billing isn't just a back-office function for us; it's a strategic product area that directly impacts our ability to win in new markets and scale globally. Our billing platform enables finance teams to accurately analyse and forecast travel spend, the automation to streamline their accounting, and the accuracy to trust their financials. Thanks to our AI-powered invoice collection service and partner integrations, we help customers save thousands in VAT reclaims. We are on a mission to make complex financial operations feel effortless.

As the Staff Product Manager for Billing, you will own the vision, strategy, and execution for a product that is the financial engine of our business. You will transform complex challenges—from international tax compliance to AI-powered invoice data extraction—into a seamless, scalable, and intelligent billing platform. This is a mission-critical role where you will directly shape our commercial strategy, enhance customer trust, and build a key pillar of our competitive advantage.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our Spend ecosystem

  • Drive high-velocity execution with a world class team of making bold, fast bets informed customer feedback, data, market research, and deep intuition for how AI can reshape how teams operate

  • Use customer insights with technical possibilities, crafting intuitive user experiences that simplify the user experience

  • Help millions of employees and thousands of finance teams seamlessly manage expenses, cards, and invoice processing.

  • Prototype rapidly using tools like Claude and Cursor to accelerate the product development lifecycle and fast-forward to production-ready products.

  • Stay deeply plugged into AI research, industry trends, and emergent applications, filtering signal from noise and applying it creatively to Perk products

  • Empower Your Team: Lead with a servant-leadership approach help stay focused, remove distractions, and foster creativity and collaboration

What You’ll Need

  • Experience That Counts: Significant experience in a tech company, with proven capability as a Product Manager. Experience working on a Tax product is a strong plus. Bonus if you have experience in development, design, or business roles (though not a must).

  • Finance and accounting: You have a working knowledge of accounting reconciliation and finance operations.

  • Strong customer empathy and design thinking, with a passion to understand the entire expense lifecycle — from the moment of spend inception through automated reconciliation to final posting in the ERP system — and the specific friction points unique to complex accounting workflows

  • Fluency in data and how to make data-driven product decisions

  • Experience evaluating product decisions and prioritization trade-offs

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence small teams of engineers & designers toward a common goal

  • Ability to collaborate with multiple stakeholders and large cross-functional teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on research and tools.

  • Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Bolt, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments like Figma and Git.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation including equity in the company

  • Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge

  • Health perks such as private healthcare or gym allowance depending on your location

  • "Flexible compensation plan" to help you diversify and increase the net salary

  • Unforgettable Perk events including travel to one of our hubs

  • Mental health support tool for your wellbeing

  • Exponential growth opportunities

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied ML Engineer based in United Kingdom.

As an Applied ML Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of machine learning research, experimentation, and production engineering.
You’ll turn ideas from research papers into rigorous experiments, measurable evidence, and reliable products.
The role spans model evaluation, model internals, inference infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing product experiences.
You’ll work hands-on with modern ML models, designing evaluations that reveal what methods can—and cannot—demonstrate.
You’ll also build production-grade tooling that makes complex experiments repeatable, observable, and accessible to users.
The environment values technical judgment, ownership, scientific rigor, and the ability to move comfortably across the technology stack.
It’s an opportunity to help transform emerging ML techniques into practical systems that people can trust.


Accountabilities
  • Reproduce and evaluate machine learning research methods using open-weight and API-accessible models.
  • Design evaluation datasets, probes, scoring approaches, baselines, calibration tests, and experiment harnesses.
  • Work directly with model weights, logits, hidden states, activations, model APIs, and inference infrastructure when required.
  • Build and extend evaluation infrastructure covering experiment runners, judges, persistence, orchestration, reporting, and reproducibility.
  • Turn research workflows into intuitive product experiences, including experiment configuration, execution, traces, comparisons, reports, and review workflows.
  • Investigate how verification methods behave when models are modified through fine-tuning, merging, quantization, distillation, safety removal, or deliberate evasion.
  • Design controlled experiments that distinguish meaningful signals from artifacts, confounders, and misleading correlations.
  • Produce clear technical reports that separate measured evidence from interpretation and hypotheses.
  • Deliver production-quality systems with APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, observability, testing, deployment, and documentation.
  • Contribute across research, experimentation, engineering, and product as priorities evolve.
  • During the first six months, reproduce and document at least one published model-provenance or verification method, including its capabilities, assumptions, and limitations.
  • Build a repeatable model-verification runner with versioned inputs, artifacts, metrics, and reports, and make at least one verification workflow accessible through the product interface.
  • Run controlled experiments across base, fine-tuned, merged, quantized, and known distilled models, improving understanding of when verification methods succeed, fail, and why.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong Python engineering skills, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
    • Solid understanding of machine learning evaluation, including dataset design, baselines, metrics, calibration, false positives and negatives, statistical uncertainty, and reproducibility.
    • Ability to read ML research papers critically and implement methods from first principles rather than relying entirely on existing packages.
    • Professional software engineering experience beyond notebooks, including APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, logging, testing, deployment, and documentation.
    • Familiarity with open-weight models and a practical understanding of how modern LLM inference systems operate.
    • Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, with sufficient React/TypeScript knowledge to help make complex experiments and results understandable to users.
    • Strong experimental and analytical judgment, particularly around distinguishing what evidence demonstrates from what it merely suggests.
    • High ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive projects forward independently.
    • Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change quickly and engineers may operate across multiple functions.
    • Experience with model provenance, fingerprinting, watermarking, distillation detection, red-teaming, safety evaluation, interpretability, or related areas is a plus.
    • Experience with activation and representation analysis, probing, model hooks, logits, hidden states, or other model-internals techniques is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with evaluation and inference infrastructure such as DSPy, LiteLLM, Temporal, Ray, vLLM, PostgreSQL/pgvector, or comparable technologies is beneficial.
    • Experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, data visualization, or experiment dashboards is a plus.
    • Experience running and serving open-weight models on GPUs, including reasoning about latency, throughput, memory, precision, and cost trade-offs, is valuable.
    • Experience designing adversarial evaluations or testing systems against deliberate attempts to evade detection is an advantage.
    • A strong commitment to producing production-quality code, tests, tooling, and documentation that other engineers can confidently operate and extend.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work on applied machine learning at the intersection of research, experimentation, engineering, and product.
      • End-to-end ownership across model evaluation, model internals, infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing experiences.
      • Exposure to modern open-weight models, LLM inference systems, and emerging ML verification techniques.

About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid global growth and the launch of our AI Materials Foundry, we are seeking a Foundry Partnership Manager to join our Partnerships team and report directly to our Head of Partnerships. This is a high visibility role for a senior candidate.

Your Impact

In this role you will be engaging the global partner ecosystem that accelerates the adoption of our AI Materials platform, which is critical for delivering next-generation semiconductor and advanced materials to market.

 

Your main focus initially will be establishing cross-cultural operational workflows across our Europe and US hub.

What You Will Do

Ecosystem Cultivation & Community Activation

  • Act as the primary operational bridge for tech partners, enterprise clients, and elite research institutions across Europe, the USA, and APAC.

  • Design, coordinate, and host a comprehensive global engagement strategy.

  • Build scalable partner frameworks.

Cross-Cultural Operations & Project Management

  • Manage day-to-day engagement with global stakeholders.

  • Coordinate cross-functional timelines between external partner teams and CuspAI leadership.

Interdisciplinary Collaboration

  • Partner closely with our Head of Partnerships and Chief Strategy Officer to align ecosystem activities with our overarching roadmap.

  • Collaborate with our AI Research, Computational Chemistry, and Product teams to channel partner feedback directly into the development priorities of our agentic platform.

  • Work alongside marketing and PR functions to spotlight partner success stories, such as dramatic speedups in simulation workloads and novel applications in advanced materials research.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You have a genuine, explicit interest in how frontier AI can revolutionise materials science and a passion for bringing sustainable, impactful technologies to humanity.

  • You possess a proven track record in ecosystem management, strategic alliances, or technical community building, ideally within a high-growth startup or fast-paced deep-tech environment, alongside substantial experience communicating and building relationships with executive-level stakeholders.

  • You have experience independently creating and managing events and conferences, owning them end to end, from concept through delivery. Including initiatives run alongside or on behalf of Fortune 100 companies.

  • You demonstrate extensive global cross-cultural experience, with a proven ability to engage and build trust with senior stakeholders across international borders (e.g. Europe, USA, APAC).

  • You are a confident, charismatic communicator with direct experience hosting, moderating, and organising both virtual webinars and premium in-person events for a technical audience.

  • You have a solid foundational understanding of or proximity to the semiconductor ecosystem, hardware roadmaps, or advanced materials development.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Direct professional background working within a semiconductor foundry, design firm, or electronics materials supplier.

  • Native or professional fluency in a second language relevant to our global hubs (e.g. Japanese, Korean, German).

  • An academic background or deep personal literacy in Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, or Electrical Engineering.

  • Experience managing joint ecosystem programs alongside major hardware tech giants like NVIDIA or Meta.

Additional Considerations

There would be an expectation around you being in the office three days per week depending on which projects you’re working on at the time. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to partner sites and/or other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

People Experience Administrator (German-speaking) - People Operations

Part-time: 25 hours per week (flexible). Hybrid in London, United Kingdom.

We’re looking for a People Experience Administrator

Keep the employee journey running smoothly for iwocans across the UK and Germany. You'll support payroll in both countries, run onboarding and offboarding, and be the first port of call for questions. This is a part-time role, ideally 25-hours spread across five days, but if a different pattern suits you better, we can be flexible.

The team
The People Operations team's mission is to attract, develop and retain high performers who genuinely love being part of iwoca. The People Experience team handles the nuts and bolts of the entire employee journey, from onboarding and offboarding to background checks and visa paperwork. It looks after HR systems like BambooHR and Peakon, keeps policies up to date, and manages benefits and payroll. The team is the first point of contact for most People Operations questions.

The role

As our People Experience Administrator, you'll be the first point of contact for iwocans and the person who keeps the employee journey running smoothly, from someone's first day to their last.

Supporting payroll across our UK and German teams is a key part of the role, so you'll play a direct part in making sure every iwocan gets paid correctly and on time.

It's a broad, hands-on role at the heart of our People Operations team, with the flexibility to shape your days and hours around your life, so it suits anyone balancing work with other commitments. You'll own your work and be someone the team relies on.

In this role, you'll:

  • Support the payroll process across our UK and German entities, working with Finance and our People Partners so every iwocan gets paid correctly and on time.

  • Own the day-to-day running of our UK and German benefits, and be the person iwocans come to when they have a question about them.

  • Maintain our HR database (BambooHR) through careful data entry and regular audits, keeping people data accurate across both countries.

  • Coordinate onboarding for every new iwocan, from background checks to new-starter set-up, so their first days run seamlessly.

  • Run the offboarding process, booking and tracking exit interviews.

  • Answer iwocans' day-to-day questions, directly or through our ticketing system.

  • Work across People processes in both the UK and Germany.

The requirements

  • Ideally 1-3 years' experience in a People Operations or HR administration role.

  • Fluent in German and English, so you can confidently support our German team and the payroll and benefit administration.

  • Confident with HR systems (we use BambooHR and Ashby), accurate with data and reporting, and careful with confidential information.

  • Comfortable working independently and juggling competing priorities.

  • Comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to work faster and improve the quality of your work, with good judgement about when to use them.

  • Genuinely excited by the operational side of the People Ops: you love improving processes, driving change, and being at the centre of how things get done.

The salary
These are full-time salaries that we'll pro-rate for the hours you work. We expect to pay from £32,000 - £36,000 for this role in London but, we’re open-minded and want to find the right person for this role, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is building the creative suite for the AI generation. Millions of creators and marketers already use our platform to generate speech, music, images, and video, and our social presence needs to match the speed and ambition of the product.

We are looking for a Social Media Manager to own and elevate the social presence across both the ElevenLabs and ElevenCreative brands. You will own ElevenCreative on X and LinkedIn, ElevenLabs on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, and our community on Discord.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of content strategy, lightweight video editing, and community. You will plan the calendar, capture product moments with our AI creative producers and product teams, and do the recording and editing yourself using tools like Screen Studio, assembling clips, adding text and motion, and adapting each post natively for its platform. You will stay ahead of trends and cultural moments, up-level the brand voice and the quality bar across channels, track performance, and use the data to keep improving what we publish.

The right person lives on social platforms, understands what makes content work natively on each one, and has strong opinions about how an AI-native brand should show up. You should be comfortable writing sharp copy, running a content calendar across multiple channels, and thinking strategically about audience growth and brand positioning.

What you will do

  • Own the social content calendar across X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn for both ElevenCreative and ElevenLabs, plus our community on Discord, from planning through publishing

  • Coordinate with AI creative producers and product teams to capture product moments such as screen recordings, motion demos, and feature walkthroughs, and adapt them into social-ready assets

  • Record and edit content yourself using tools like Screen Studio, assembling clips, adding text and motion overlays, and formatting natively for each platform

  • Own and grow our Discord community, sparking conversation, surfacing feedback, and keeping it active

  • Plan and execute social content around product launches, feature releases, and company moments

  • Work with the creator partnerships and community teams to source creator work, align on campaigns, and amplify content across channels

  • Monitor platform analytics, tracking engagement, reach, follower growth, and conversion, and use the data to refine strategy

  • Stay ahead of platform trends, algorithm changes, and cultural moments to find opportunities for the brand

  • Up-level the brand voice and raise the quality bar across every channel, keeping a consistent identity

  • Manage community engagement across platforms, responding to comments, surfacing feedback, and joining the right conversations

  • Develop and iterate on content formats that drive engagement and show product capabilities to creators and marketers

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience managing social media accounts for a technology or creative tools company, with a portfolio of work you can share

  • Ability to do lightweight video editing, assembling clips, adding text and motion overlays, and formatting content for different platforms

  • Comfortable recording and editing your own content with tools like Screen Studio, turning product moments into native posts without waiting on a producer

  • Proven ability to write sharp, platform-native copy across X, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn

  • Fluency in social analytics, you know how to pull insights from native platform dashboards and translate them into content decisions

  • Experience coordinating content across cross-functional teams (video, community, partnerships, product marketing)

  • A genuine understanding of the AI and creative tools landscape, you follow the space, use the tools, and have informed opinions about where things are headed

Bonus

  • Experience managing social for a product used by creators and marketers (e.g., Adobe, Canva, Figma, Runway, or similar)

  • Experience running or growing a community channel such as Discord

  • Experience with social scheduling and management tools (Sprout Social, Later, Buffer, or similar)

  • Experience building a social presence from early stage or leading a rebrand on social

  • Multilingual capabilities

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Lead social strategy across all ElevenLabs brands and sub-brands as the social function scales

  • Move into a broader content role spanning video, editorial, and social

  • Expand into brand marketing or creative direction as the growth team evolves

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
